units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:17">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>מעשה … שׁשָׁלְקוּ זונה וכ׳</he> it happened that the disciples of R. Yishm. dissected the body of a prostitute that had been condemned to death &c.

senses.gloss: [to make smooth,] to boil thoroughly, boil to a pulp, seethe.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:1">Maasr. IV, 1</cite> <he>הכובש חשׁוֹלֵק וכ׳</he> he who presses, boils, or salts (vegetables, olives &c.) … is bound to give tithes.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:15">Tosef. Bets. II, 15</cite> <he>ש׳ הימנו וכ׳</he> if he seethed a small portion of the Passover lamb, contrad. to <cite ref="B01359"><he>בישל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:9">Naz. VI, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Nazir 45b:10">45ᵇ</cite>) <he>היה מבשל … או שׁוֹלְקָן</he> Y. ed. a. Bab. (Mish. ed. <he>שְׁלָקָן</he>) having cooked or seethed the peace-offering; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01260"><he>שָׁלוּק</he></cite>; f. <he>שְלוּקָה</he>. Y. ib. 55ᶜ top <he>מתני׳ אמרה הש׳ קרוי מבושל</he> this Mishnah indicates that ‘seethed’ is called cooked.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:1">Ned. VI, 1</cite> <he>הנודר מן המבושל מותר בצלי ובש׳</he> he who vows abstinence from ‘what is cooked’ is permitted to eat what is roasted or seethed.

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:6">Ukts. II, 6</cite> <he>ביצה ש׳</he> a hard-boiled egg; <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:15">Tosef. ib. II, 15</cite>; <he>ביצה ש׳ וביצה טרמיסא</he> (read: <cite ref="I00726"><he>טרומיטא</he></cite>) a hard-boiled egg, or an egg boiled down to a pill, v. <cite ref="I00726"><he>טְרוֹמִיטָא</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make smooth, (of melons) to trim and rub.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>אבטיח משׁיְשַׁלֵּק</he> melons are subject to tithes as soon as the gardener trims them; <he>ואם אינו מְשַׁלֵּק וכ׳</he> and if he does not trim them (before storing) &c.; Tosef. ib. I, 6 <he>תורמין … אע״פ שלא ש׳</he> you must give T’rumah of cucumbers and gourds, even if you do not trim them; a. e.

senses.gloss: to boil. Tanḥ. Bresh. 7 אין לך … ואתה שוקד לשַׁלְּקוֹ וכ׳ there is nothing more bitter than the lupine, but thou takest pains to boil and sweeten it &c. Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 נקבץ ונְשַׁלֵּק מהן we will collect them (the locusts) and boil (and preserve) them in casks.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:8">Neg. XI, 8</cite> <he>השתי משׁיִשָּׁלֵק</he> warp is susceptible of uncleanness when it is boiled (Var. <he>משׁיִשָּׁלֶה</he> when it is taken out of the water); Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 5, ch. XIII.
